features.name: seven_attr_active_fraction
features.description: Fraction of attribute_1 through attribute_7 that are active in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact stroke-density projection for sparse versus dense display patterns.
features.formula: (np.where((attribute_1 == 1) | (attribute_1 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_2 == 1) | (attribute_2 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_3 == 1) | (attribute_3 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_4 == 1) | (attribute_4 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_5 == 1) | (attribute_5 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_6 == 1) | (attribute_6 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where((attribute_7 == 1) | (attribute_7 == '1'), 1.0, 0.0)) / 7.0

features.name: display_horizontal_fraction
features.description: Fraction of conventional horizontal display bars attribute_1, attribute_4, and attribute_7 that are active.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes top, middle, and bottom bar intensity as one margin-friendly coordinate.

features.name: display_vertical_pair_completion
features.description: Average completion of same-side vertical display pairs: attribute_2 with attribute_5 and attribute_3 with attribute_6.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a simple side-continuity interaction that separate raw bits do not express directly.

features.name: display_shape_coherence_judgment
features.description: Expert-assigned score from 0.0 to 1.0 based only on attribute_1 through attribute_7; higher values mean the active bars form a coherent seven-segment numeral-like shape with ordinary connectivity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a smooth visual-quality cue for noisy rows and atypical display shapes.

features.name: display_shape_ambiguity_judgment
features.description: Expert-assigned score from 0.0 to 1.0 based only on attribute_1 through attribute_7; higher values mean the visible bars are visually ambiguous, damaged, or compatible with several numeral-like shapes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a smooth uncertainty cue for rows with unclear or conflicting display geometry.
